note: W11a-1: how a state of an expectation (graph.structure: missing, inferred, excess, declined, present, empty ... - an open list of the kernel's data) is drawn in the window „Struktura projektu”. A mapping is data: a preset id here, or an object {states: {<state>: <signs>}} given as the window parameter `mapping`. Signs are an open list read by structure-state.ts (opacity, border, icon, color, size, order, hidden, weight); a sign the page does not read is said, never dropped silently. A value {setting: key} reads a setting of the person (preset: me_inferred_opacity, the same as on the screen „Ty”). Every preset is an example.
